reason: Notify John Smith's patient-facing app of status changes on his dental clearance referral (Task/task-360x-dental-referral), so the app can surface milestone updates (referral sent, accepted, appointment scheduled, DDC received, clearance transmitted, PA approved) without John needing to call either office.

note.text: Per the HL7 FHIR Subscriptions R4 Backport IG: the SubscriptionTopic canonical URL is carried directly in Subscription.criteria (not via a separate topic-canonical extension, which is how some non-HL7 implementations, e.g. Carequality's, model it -- verified against the HL7 UV IG directly before building this resource). Notifications fire on changes to the referral Task (task-360x-dental-referral) -- see the use case's master 'Key FHIR Resources Exercised' table, which names Subscription/SubscriptionStatus as the mechanism for referral sent, appointment scheduled, DDC received, clearance transmitted, and PA approved milestones. This Subscription should have existed from Interaction 1 onward; it was not built until this gap was identified retroactively -- placed in base/ (not a specific interaction folder) since it's ongoing infrastructure spanning the whole use case, not tied to one moment.
